程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

接口 Inventory

所有超级接口:
Iterable<ItemStack>
所有已知子接口:
AnvilInventory, BeaconInventory, BrewerInventory, CraftingInventory, DoubleChestInventory, EnchantingInventory, FurnaceInventory, HorseInventory, MerchantInventory, PlayerInventory
public interface Inventory extends Iterable<ItemStack>
Interface to the various inventories. Behavior relating to Material.AIR is unspecified. 各种物品栏的接口。与 Material.AIR 相关的行为未指定。

    • getMaxStackSize

      int getMaxStackSize()
      Returns the maximum stack size for an ItemStack in this inventory. 返回该物品栏中单个 ItemStack 的最大堆叠数。
      返回:
      The maximum size for an ItemStack in this inventory. 该物品栏中单个 ItemStack 的最大堆叠数。

    • setMaxStackSize

      void setMaxStackSize(int size)
      This method allows you to change the maximum stack size for an inventory. 此方法允许你更改物品栏的最大堆叠数。

      Caveats:

      • Not all inventories respect this value. 并非所有物品栏都会遵循此值。
      • Stacks larger than 127 may be clipped when the world is saved. 大于 127 的堆叠在保存世界时可能被截断。
      • This value is not guaranteed to be preserved; be sure to set it before every time you want to set a slot over the max stack size. 此值不保证被保留；每次要在超过最大堆叠数的槽位设置物品之前，务必重新设置它。
      • Stacks larger than the default max size for this type of inventory may not display correctly in the client. 超过此类物品栏默认最大堆叠数的堆叠可能在客户端中显示不正常。
      参数:
      size - The new maximum stack size for items in this inventory. 该物品栏中物品的新最大堆叠数。

    • addItem

      HashMap<Integer,ItemStack> addItem(ItemStack... items) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Stores the given ItemStacks in the inventory. This will try to fill existing stacks and empty slots as well as it can. 将给定的 ItemStack 存入物品栏。它会尽可能填充现有堆叠和空槽位。

      The returned HashMap contains what it couldn't store, where the key is the index of the parameter, and the value is the ItemStack at that index of the varargs parameter. If all items are stored, it will return an empty HashMap. 返回的 HashMap 包含无法存入的内容，其中键为参数的索引，值为可变参数对应位置的 ItemStack。若所有物品都存入成功，则返回空 HashMap。

      If you pass in ItemStacks which exceed the maximum stack size for the Material, first they will be added to partial stacks where Material.getMaxStackSize() is not exceeded, up to Material.getMaxStackSize(). When there are no partial stacks left stacks will be split on Inventory.getMaxStackSize() allowing you to exceed the maximum stack size for that material. 如果传入的 ItemStack 超过了该 Material 的最大堆叠数，它们会先被加入 Material.getMaxStackSize() 未被超过的部分堆叠，直至达到 Material.getMaxStackSize()。当没有部分堆叠剩余时，堆叠将按 Inventory.getMaxStackSize() 拆分，使你可以超过该材料的最大堆叠数。

      参数:
      items - The ItemStacks to add 要添加的 ItemStack
      返回:
      A HashMap containing items that didn't fit. 包含未能放入的物品的 HashMap。
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if items or any element in it is null 若 items 或其中任何元素为 null

    • removeItem

      HashMap<Integer,ItemStack> removeItem(ItemStack... items) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Removes the given ItemStacks from the inventory. 从物品栏中移除给定的 ItemStack。

      It will try to remove 'as much as possible' from the types and amounts you give as arguments. 它会尽量按你传入参数的类型和数量“尽可能多地”移除。

      The returned HashMap contains what it couldn't remove, where the key is the index of the parameter, and the value is the ItemStack at that index of the varargs parameter. If all the given ItemStacks are removed, it will return an empty HashMap. 返回的 HashMap 包含无法移除的内容，其中键为参数的索引，值为可变参数对应位置的 ItemStack。若所有给定的 ItemStack 都被移除，则返回空 HashMap。

      参数:
      items - The ItemStacks to remove 要移除的 ItemStack
      返回:
      A HashMap containing items that couldn't be removed. 包含无法移除的物品的 HashMap。
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if items is null 若 items 为 null

    • setContents

      void setContents(ItemStack[] items) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Completely replaces the inventory's contents. Removes all existing contents and replaces it with the ItemStacks given in the array. 完全替换物品栏的内容物。移除所有现有内容物，并替换为数组中给定的 ItemStack。
      参数:
      items - A complete replacement for the contents; the length must be less than or equal to getSize(). 内容物的完整替换；长度必须小于等于 getSize()。
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the array has more items than the inventory. 若数组中的物品数多于物品栏容量。

    • contains

      boolean contains(ItemStack item)
      Checks if the inventory contains any ItemStacks matching the given ItemStack. 检查物品栏是否包含与给定 ItemStack 匹配的 ItemStack。

      This will only return true if both the type and the amount of the stack match. 只有当堆叠的类型和数量都匹配时才会返回 true。

      返回:
      false if item is null, true if any exactly matching ItemStacks were found 若 item 为 null 则为 false；若找到任何完全匹配的 ItemStack 则为 true

    • contains

      boolean contains(ItemStack item, int amount)
      Checks if the inventory contains at least the minimum amount specified of exactly matching ItemStacks. 检查物品栏是否包含至少指定数量的完全匹配的 ItemStack

      An ItemStack only counts if both the type and the amount of the stack match. 只有当堆叠的类型和数量都匹配时，ItemStack 才会被计入。

      参数:
      item - the ItemStack to match against 要匹配的 ItemStack
      amount - how many identical stacks to check for 要检查的相同堆叠数量
      返回:
      false if item is null, true if amount less than 1, true if amount of exactly matching ItemStacks were found 若 item 为 null 则为 false；若 amount 小于 1 则为 true；若找到指定数量的完全匹配 ItemStack 则为 true
      另请参阅:
      • containsAtLeast(ItemStack, int)

      参数:

      amount - the minimum amount 最小数量

    • getViewers

      List<HumanEntity> getViewers()
      Gets a list of players viewing the inventory. Note that a player is considered to be viewing their own inventory and internal crafting screen even when said inventory is not open. They will normally be considered to be viewing their inventory even when they have a different inventory screen open, but it's possible for customized inventory screens to exclude the viewer's inventory, so this should never be assumed to be non-empty. 获取正在查看该物品栏的玩家列表。注意，即使玩家自己的物品栏未打开，也被视为正在查看自己的物品栏和内置合成界面。通常即使他们打开的是其他物品栏界面，也会被视为正在查看自己的物品栏，但自定义物品栏界面可能会排除查看者自己的物品栏，因此绝不应假定此列表非空。
      返回:
      A list of HumanEntities who are viewing this Inventory. 正在查看该物品栏的 HumanEntity 列表。

    • iterator

      ListIterator<ItemStack> iterator(int index)
      Returns an iterator starting at the given index. If the index is positive, then the first call to next() will return the item at that index; if it is negative, the first call to previous will return the item at index (getSize() + index). 返回从给定索引开始的迭代器。若索引为正，则首次调用 next() 将返回该索引处的物品；若为负，则首次调用 previous 将返回索引 (getSize() + index) 处的物品。
      参数:
      index - The index. 索引。
      返回:
      An iterator. 一个迭代器。
